faq.title: Before you start.
faq.intro: The questions business owners ask us most.

items.q: Isn't an ERP only for big companies?
items.a: No. The bigger a business grows without one, the more expensive the clean-up. We size the system to your company and start with whatever wastes the most of your time.

items.q: We already have someone for our website. Do we have to change everything?
items.a: No. The real question is who owns the link between your website and your stock. We can connect what you already have, or take over the whole thing if that's simpler.

It depends on what needs to be built: business email costs little, a full ERP more. After the audit you get a written proposal with the scope and the price. To compare, count the hours your team spends each month re-typing the same data.
With a free 30-minute audit: you show us how you work, we tell you what we'd change. Then a demo and a written proposal. Nothing is committed until you say yes.
Your data and your servers are yours. You get full documentation, and we use open-source software, so another provider could take over.
We stay. Hosting, nightly backups, monitoring, updates and support: your system keeps being looked after and improved.

about.heading: A technical team that builds — and stays.
about.intro: Many companies buy their website from a freelancer, their ERP from another provider and their email from a third. Then they spend years paying for the gaps between them. Coshift is a technical agency in Algiers that closes those gaps: we build the whole system, then run it on our own infrastructure.

scope.title: The whole system, not one slice.
scope.body: Website, ERP, apps, email, servers: we cover all of it, so no seam is left for you to manage. Large integrators are out of reach for an SME, freelancers only cover a slice. We sit in between, on purpose.

ownership.title: We run what we build.
ownership.body: Our own infrastructure, our own monitoring, our own backups. The project doesn't end at handover: we keep running it and improving it.

engineering.title: Code, not just settings.
engineering.body: When standard software isn't enough, we build the missing module. And we deliver in French, Arabic and English.

location.heading: Where to find us.
location.body: In Algiers. We work with SMEs and industrial companies that have outgrown Excel and WhatsApp but can't justify a large integrator.
